name: gaia-review-meta-close
description: Close out a review/meta branch that lands an evidence-ingest / curation batch: create the named nodes, ingest verified evidence, appraise Trust Magnitude, calibrate stars, wire suites, correct upstream naming, stage ONLY the intended artifacts (dropping CRLF churn and blocking leaks), validate, and open the PR. Use when a curation/ingest batch is verified and ready to land, or when the user says "close the review/meta branch", "land the ingest batch", "wrap up the intake PR", "/gaia-review-meta-close". Wraps the deterministic hygiene in scripts/review_meta_close.py and gates the judgment calls (calibration, Origin, suite promotion, naming, merge) behind explicit human checkpoints.

python scripts/review_meta_close.py validate    # gaia dev validate, UTF-8-safe, must PASS
